summary: Regression + new-feature testing for QC Station module (tablet-first rejection capture) and Rejection Reasons visual config. Found & fixed one CRITICAL backend bug (POST/PUT /api/production/rejection-reasons returned 500 because Pydantic models were missing color/icon/image fields). After fix, 9/9 QC Station backend tests pass and the full UI flow works: batch → stage → capture (tap +1, undo -1, crates stepper), autosave, session resume, submit, error toast on pending<=0. Rejection Reasons admin config renders color+icon tile cards and edit preloads existing values.

critical.issue: AttributeError: RejectionReasonCreate/Update object has no attribute 'color'. Pydantic models did not declare color/icon/image but endpoint code reads them → HTTP 500 for every create/update.
critical.status: FIXED by testing agent (added optional color/icon/image fields to the models)

action_items: None blocking — QC Station feature is functionally complete after the RejectionReasonCreate/Update model fix.

Optional: consider auto-refreshing the Active Batches list on the QC Station step 1 after submit — currently returns to batch list which is correct, but the batch's stage pending count is only reflected on next stage tap.
critical_code_review_comments: Pydantic model schema drift: RejectionReasonCreate/Update models must always stay in sync with fields consumed by the handler. This bug was invisible during main-agent curl testing because those tests must have submitted only {name}. Recommend adding a schema-level test or using `data.model_dump()` and spreading into the doc.

In submit_qc_session, reason names are resolved by a single {'id': {'$in': reason_ids}} query — good. However, if a reason was deleted between tapping and submitting, its counts silently become 'Unknown'. Consider warning the operator or blocking submit.
QCStation.js and RejectionReasons.js follow good testid conventions and are well-scoped — no >700 line concerns.

record_inspection has a subtle constraint: total_rej_bottles cannot exceed qty_inspected * bottles_per_crate per entry. On QC Station, if a user taps many rejections but sets crates=1 with a low bottles_per_crate, submit will 400. UI could surface this preemptively (disable submit or show hint) — minor UX polish.

rca of the issue: RCA — Rejection Reasons POST 500: Pydantic model RejectionReasonCreate declared only {name, description}, but the create handler read data.color / data.icon / data.image. Pydantic v2 raises AttributeError on undeclared attributes. Repro: POST /api/production/rejection-reasons with body {"name":"x","color":"#fff","icon":"circle"} → 500 (backend log: AttributeError: 'RejectionReasonCreate' object has no attribute 'color'). Mitigation: added color/icon/image as Optional[str] to both Create and Update models. Verified: subsequent POST returned 200 with the payload persisted and reflected on GET.
